V1.verbatim: YouTube is constantly changing and improving the Service. As part of this continual evolution of our digital content and services, we may make modifications or changes (to all or part of the Service) such as adding or removing features and functionalities, offering new digital content or services or discontinuing old ones.
V1.onde: Doc 1 (ToS IE), seção "Develop, Improve and Update the Service"
V1.por_que: Registro vinculante: só linguagem de melhoria/modificação do serviço, sem menção a teste ou experimento — evidência para o nível do registro vinculante sozinho (nível 1).

V1.verbatim: YouTube is constantly changing and improving the Service. As part of this continual evolution of our digital content and services, we may make modifications or changes (to all or part of the Service) such as adding or removing features and functionalities, offering new digital content or services or discontinuing old ones.
V1.onde: Doc 2 (ToS IT), seção "Develop, Improve and Update the Service"
V1.por_que: Confirma que o ToS (vinculante) não nomeia experimentação, apenas melhoria contínua.

V1.verbatim: We use the information we collect in existing services to help us develop new ones.
V1.onde: Doc 3 (Privacy Policy), seção "Why Google collects data" → "Develop new services"
V1.por_que: Política de privacidade (vinculante) usa linguagem de desenvolvimento/melhoria, sem nomear teste em usuários.

V1.verbatim: Perform research that improves our services for our users and benefits the public.
V1.onde: Doc 3 (Privacy Policy), "European requirements" → tabela de bases legais, "To maintain and improve Google services"
V1.por_que: Menciona "research" no registro vinculante, mas sem nomear experimento, variantes ou A/B — relevante para a fronteira 1 vs 2 vs 3.

V1.verbatim: YouTube uses the `__Secure-ROLLOUT_TOKEN` cookie to launch new features and measure related impact when other existing cookies and identifiers cannot be used for the same purpose.
V1.por_que: Documento de tecnologias vinculado à política: menciona lançamento de novas features e medição de impacto, sem nomear A/B ou grupos — candidato a nível 2.

V1.verbatim: Creators can test and compare up to 3 different titles and thumbnails. At the end of the test, the title or combination of title and thumbnail with the highest watch time will be shown to all viewers.
V1.onde: Doc 7 (Help Centre, "A/B test titles & thumbnails"), abertura
V1.por_que: Nomeia teste A/B com variantes servidas a espectadores — evidência direta de nível 3, em registro de help centre (não-vinculante).

V1.verbatim: We may maintain a small percentage of traffic as a control group of viewers that are excluded from the experiment. The control group will only see the default thumbnail and title. The video performance from the control group is excluded from the experiment calculations.
V1.onde: Doc 7, nota em "Review or stop A/B tests" e FAQ "Control group"
V1.por_que: Grupo de controle explícito e exclusão do experimento: teto 3 inequívoco, fora do registro vinculante.

V1.verbatim: YouTube’s A/B tests are true, concurrent A/B/C tests. This means all variations are shown to viewers at the same time.
V1.onde: Doc 7, FAQ "Why am I getting different test results?"
V1.por_que: Descreve randomização/variantes concorrentes servidas a usuários distintos — nível 3.

V1.verbatim: YouTube product teams are constantly testing out new tools and features to help you find, watch, share and create content more easily. These test features (sometimes also called “betas” or “experiments”) are usually available for a short period of time and only for a small group of people.
V1.onde: Doc 8 (Community thread "YouTube test features and experiments"), post original
V1.por_que: Uso explícito de "experiments" em sentido experimental, com subgrupo de usuários — nível 3 em registro não-vinculante (fórum de comunidade).

V1.verbatim: If you ever notice that YouTube looks a bit different for you than it does for your friend or family member, you’re likely seeing one of these experiments.
V1.por_que: Descreve explicitamente variantes diferentes servidas a usuários diferentes.

V1.verbatim: YouTube Premium members can learn and try multiple experimental YouTube features at youtube.com/new .
V1.onde: Doc 6 (Help Centre, "Test feature experiments at Youtube.com/new")
V1.por_que: Reconhecimento de experimentação em help centre (não-vinculante); relevante para o par teto/registro.

V2.verbatim: YouTube is constantly changing and improving the Service.

V2.por_que: Enquadramento de service improvement no registro vinculante.

V2.verbatim: We use your information to deliver our services , like processing the terms you search for in order to return results or helping you share content by suggesting recipients from your contacts.
V2.onde: Doc 3 (Privacy Policy), "Why Google collects data" → "Provide our services"

V2.verbatim: Perform research that improves our services for our users and benefits the public. For example, improving Google Translate’s translation quality and increasing the availability of Translate in more languages.
V2.onde: Doc 3 (Privacy Policy), tabela de bases legais, "To maintain and improve Google services"
V2.por_que: Co-ocorrência clara: research + service improvement, com apelo a benefício público.

V2.verbatim: Perform research that improves our services for our users and benefits the public.
V2.onde: Doc 4 (Privacy Policy en-GB), tabela de bases legais
V2.por_que: Confirma o enquadramento research + benefício público na versão IE/en-GB.

V2.verbatim: Our team is focused on improving our systems to make them accurate and useful for our creators.
V2.onde: Doc 7, FAQ "How can I provide feedback?"
V2.por_que: Experimentação A/B enquadrada como melhoria do serviço para criadores.

V2.verbatim: However, we believe that deciding a “winner” by watch time will best support creators’ growth.
V2.onde: Doc 7, FAQ "Why am I getting different test results?"
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de benefício ao criador/comunidade de criadores — borderline social-good.

V2.verbatim: YouTube product teams are constantly testing out new tools and features to help you find, watch, share and create content more easily.
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de experimentação como melhoria de serviço/utilidade ao usuário.

V2.verbatim: Be sure to give YouTube feedback and report any potential technical issues – our teams use this information and experiment results to help us decide if, when, and how to release these features more broadly.
V2.por_que: Resultados de experimento como insumo de decisão de produto — service improvement; não há linguagem de pesquisa com sujeitos humanos.

Crediamo che tutti debbano avere la possibilità di esprimersi
e che il mondo sia un luogo migliore quando ascoltiamo,
condividiamo e costruiamo community attraverso le nostre
storie.

V3.verbatim: Creators can test and compare up to 3 different titles and thumbnails.
V3.por_que: V3a/V3b: nomeia superfície testada (títulos e miniaturas) e alvo do experimento (copy/apresentação).

To help your video get high quality engagement, we optimize tests for overall watch time over other metrics, like click-through-rate.

V3.por_que: Nomeia métrica-alvo de otimização do experimento (watch time / engajamento).

V3.por_que: V3c: experimento específico e ativo divulgado, com superfície (Home feed) e alvo (layout/apresentação).

V3.por_que: V3-pricing: experimento que varia o varejista servido para o mesmo produto — relevante para avaliar se preço/oferta comercial é alvo nomeado; aparece só em registro não-vinculante (fórum).

V3.verbatim: This experiment is currently available for YouTube Premium members 18+ in the US who opt-in via youtube.com/new .

V3.verbatim: we may make modifications or changes (to all or part of the Service) such as adding or removing features and functionalities

V4.verbatim: Perform research that improves our services for our users and benefits the public. For example, improving Google Translate’s translation quality and increasing the availability of Translate in more languages.

V4.verbatim: We ask for your consent to process your data for specific purposes and you have the right to withdraw your consent at any time.

V4.verbatim: How you use Google services and your privacy settings will determine what data is processed, the purposes for which this data is processed, and the legal bases for processing data.

V4.verbatim: If European Union (EU) or United Kingdom (UK) data protection law applies to the processing of your information, we provide the controls described in this policy so you can exercise your rights
V4.por_que: V4_region_gated: a seção de bases legais é condicionada à aplicabilidade do direito da UE/UK, não a IP/locale explícito.

V4.verbatim: If European Union (EU) or United Kingdom (UK) data protection law applies to the processing of your information, we provide the controls described in this policy so that you can exercise your rights to request access to, update, remove and restrict the processing of your information.

V4.verbatim: To perform a contract with you, such as loading a YouTube video or processing, fulfilling and delivering your order when you purchase services or physical goods from us.

V4.por_que: Base contratual declarada para prestação do serviço; avaliador precisa julgar se cobre experimentação (aparentemente não).

V5.verbatim: Decide what types of activity you’d like saved in your account. For example, if you have YouTube History turned on, the videos you watch and the things you search for are saved in your account so you can get better recommendations and remember where you left off.
